why: Resolves the one setting that has nothing to resolve to a constant -- and picks the constant that makes it invisible to anyone testing on a machine that never needed a cheaper preset. Every layer downstream reads the effective value (the Settings control paints from it, `loop.ts` builds the renderer from it), so the store keeps the player's choice, the toggle keeps writing it, and nothing anywhere ever draws at anything but `high`. The three suites named here are the three consumers, which is why it takes all three to say where the value stopped.
killedBy: resolveEffectiveSettings: audio, UI scale and quality pass through ungated passes the render-quality preset straight through, on any capability set
createRouteHost: the Main Menu is painted from the stores by the page paints the STORED render-quality preset on a page with no session
startGameWith: dev flags stay off by default builds the renderer with the STORED quality preset when no flag is set (issue #540)
